card.statement:
Fix an
$\mathbb{F}$ -scheme $S$
and a morphism $S\to\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$ . Then the schemes

$\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}\times_{p_{1},\mathrm{Bun}_{T}}S\qquad\text{and}\qquad\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}\times S$

are Zariski-locally isomorphic as schemes over $C^{\mu}\times S$ . That is: there exists
an open covering $(V_{i}:i\in I)$ of $C^{\mu}\times S$ and, for any $i\in I$ , an isomorphism

$\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}\times_{C^{\mu}\times\mathrm{Bun}_{T}}V_{i}\cong(\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}\times\mathrm{Bun}_{T})\times_{C^{\mu}\times\mathrm{Bun}_{T}}V_{i}$

of schemes over $V_{i}$ .

The proof will use the following lemma.
card.label: Proposition 4.8

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
